content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High RPM detected for model family polaris14b — 3.8x baseline in last 5m. Auto-scaling at 95% capacity.
jin_oncall: seeing a lot of 429s in the frontend logs tied to polaris14b routes. paging oncall. @alex_sre @maya_runtime FYI
alex_sre: on it. grabbing recent tail logs and rate charts. can someone confirm customer-facing error spike?
emily_support: a few big customers opened tickets about increased latency and partial responses starting ~10:15 UTC. tickets mention streaming disconnects.
maya_runtime: timeline looks right. traffic surge originated from a bursty org doing embeddings+chat mix on polaris14b. throughput per-request heavier than usual.
ops_alyssa: any quick mitigation we can do without breaking availability?
jin_oncall: priority is to reduce CPU/GPU pressure while avoiding wholesale cut for customers. propose: 1) softcap RPM for polaris14b (reduce to 60% of current), 2) disable experimental function-calls on polaris14b, 3) route low-priv customers to polaris14b-quant variant. thoughts? :thinking_face:
alex_sre: makes sense. I'm worried about on-the-fly routing changes causing key mismatches. If we change RPM and toggle funcall flag, that should be low risk.
maya_runtime: agree. I can push the funcall toggle and create a weighted route to polaris14b-quant with fallback.
kevin_prod: add note to customers that we may see degraded quality for a subset while we shape traffic. ops will send a banner.
jin_oncall: executing softcap now. command: ```redwoodctl quota update --model polaris14b --rpm 1200 --scope family --reason "emergency softcap due to surge"```
alex_sre: applied RPM change, system reports target reached. watching error rate.
maya_runtime: disabling funcall feature flag for polaris14b: ```feature-flag set polaris14b funcalls false --env prod``` toggled. starting to shift 30% traffic to polaris14b-quant with request header routing. config snippet: ```routes:
  - match: header(x-variant)==quant
    weight: 30
  - default: weight: 70```
ops_alyssa: banner drafted and scheduled to go out: "Temporary rate shaping on polaris14b to stabilize latency. Some advanced features are limited."
emily_support: updating affected tickets with mitigation steps and ETA ~20m.
alex_sre: CPU/GPU utilization dropping. error rate from 9% -> 3% in last 3m. latency P95 improving.
jin_oncall: good. keep observing for 15m. if stable, we'll plan a gradual lift: +10% RPM every 5m. document changes in incident log.
maya_runtime: creating a rollback plan and canary to re-enable funcalls after RPM at safe level.
kevin_prod: are enterprise customers impacted by routing to quant variant? may need manual opt-in rollback for a couple customers.
emily_support: flagged two enterprise accounts for manual outreach.
alex_sre: note for postmortem: root cause likely an unthrottled async job hitting chat+embed path on polaris14b; recommend per-tenant burst limit and improved embedding batching.
jin_oncall: thanks all. follow-up actions: add permanent per-tenant burst limit (maya), add alert for embedding+chat co-traffic (alex), customer comms package (ops/emily). I'll keep thread open until full lift. :white_check_mark:
